networkFailure: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
serverError: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
serverRejected: The server couldn't process that request.
syncFailed: Sync failed. Your data is safe locally — we'll try again soon.

deleteFailed: Couldn't delete this item. Try again.
timeout: The server took too long to respond. Try again.

invalidSchema: This budget uses a data format the app doesn't recognize yet.
encryptFailed: Couldn't secure your changes before sending them. We'll try again soon.

uploadFailed: Couldn't upload this budget to the server.

fatalBody: The app ran into an unexpected error and needs to restart this screen.
